review_notes: Read the whole file and the statement of CuspForm.petersson_heckeTLin. I looked at three repeated patterns. (1) The Hecke self-adjointness computation in eigen_real and newperp_eigen. This is the only one I reported. (2) The "span ≤ ker (petR _)" argument in newperp and main.hkill. The shared reasoning there is only Submodule.span_le plus mem_ker, so I judged it routine and did not report it. (3) The conj_symm trick in pet_add_right and pet_smul_right. It is short and not worth a finding. I did not compile the proposed rewrite. It is a sketch built from the existing rewrites in the file, so exact rewrite forms may need small adjustment.

findings.problem: eigen_real and the second branch of newperp_eigen run the same Hecke self-adjointness argument. Both apply petersson_heckeTLin to a pair (u, v), rewrite both sides with the eigen-equations using petersson_smul_left and pet_smul_right, and read off an equation of the form conj a * ⟪u,v⟫ = c * ⟪u,v⟫. eigen_real does this for u = v = g. newperp_eigen does it for u = g and v = rescaleLin w, then rewrites by hreal and cancels a nonzero factor. The same non-trivial rewrite chain is written twice, and the second copy needs a manual sub_mul / mul_eq_zero case split.
findings.proposed_change: Add a helper in section pet, for example `pet_eigen_eq {ℓ} (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (hℓN : ¬ ℓ ∣ N) {u v} {a c : ℂ} (hu : heckeTLin k hℓ hℓN u = a • u) (hv : heckeTLin k hℓ hℓN v = c • v) : starRingEnd ℂ a * petersson u v = c * petersson u v`. Prove it by `have h1 := CuspForm.petersson_heckeTLin hℓ hℓN u v; rwa [hu, hv, CuspForm.petersson_smul_left, pet_smul_right] at h1`. Then eigen_real is `mul_right_cancel₀ hne (pet_eigen_eq hℓ hℓN ha ha)`. In newperp_eigen, lines 143–147 become `have h1 := pet_eigen_eq hℓ hℓR hTg hTv; rw [hreal] at h1`, followed by a `mul_right_cancel₀`-style or `sub_mul` step to get `(qCoeff g ℓ - c) * ⟪g, rescaleLin w⟫ = 0`. The hypotheses are exactly those already available: hTg, hTv and hreal use the same hℓR and the same CuspForm.petersson_heckeTLin import.
findings.benefit: The self-adjointness computation sits in one lemma with one proof. A maintainer changing the petersson API only has to update one place, and the orthogonality branch of newperp_eigen becomes shorter and easier to follow.

evidence.excerpt: rw [hTg, hTv, CuspForm.petersson_smul_left, pet_smul_right, hreal] at h1

CuspForm.petersson (CuspForm.heckeTLin k hp hpN f) g =
      CuspForm.petersson f (CuspForm.heckeTLin k hp hpN g)
